articles.summary: Ionworks and NOVONIX BTS are working together to connect physics-based simulation with experimental testing and materials expertise, helping battery development teams evaluate design trade-offs earlier in the program.
articles.title: Ionworks collaborates with NOVONIX Battery Technology Solutions

articles.summary: Battery engineering is still stuck in build-test-iterate cycles. The simulation tools that transformed other industries haven't worked for batteries, because the hard part isn't the geometry. It's the physics.
articles.title: Why Batteries Break Traditional Simulation Workflows
